optimizer.title: Make the stopping condition inspectable
optimizer.before:
Review the artifact.
Fix the problems.
Keep improving until it is perfect.
optimizer.after:
Record the artifact and the checks you will use.
Collect findings before editing.
Apply a scoped fix and rerun the relevant checks.
Stop when the stated severity threshold passes.
If the iteration or cost budget is exhausted, report remaining findings.
Record the final artifact, checks and unresolved limits.

research.title: Make a research answer checkable
research.before:
Research this topic.
Summarize what you find.
research.after:
State the exact research question and source boundaries.
Read the original passage supporting each material claim.
Record the source URL, date and version where available.
Preserve disagreements and unsupported questions.
Return the bounded answer, sources and unresolved gaps.

context.title: Turn a broad source into bounded context
context.before: Give the agent all the project notes.
context.after:
Choose the reference relevant to the current task.
Keep its source links and version boundaries.
Separate facts, decisions and unresolved questions.
Check the size against the agent's available context.
Open the original source when a claim matters.

default.title: Make the task and evidence explicit
default.before: Use your expertise to solve this task.
default.after:
Name the task and the inputs you actually have.
Apply the skill's stated method and checks.
Keep factual statements tied to supplied evidence.
Report missing inputs and unresolved uncertainty.
Return a result the reader can inspect.

code-deep-optimizer.title: Add an explicit input boundary to a small function

agent-deep-optimizer.title: Bound an agent definition by its job and tool permissions
agent-deep-optimizer.before:
You are an expert agent.
Use any tool to solve the problem.
Always finish successfully.
agent-deep-optimizer.after:
Job: inspect the supplied artifact and report source-bound findings.
Read only the inputs and tools named by the caller.
Ask for missing evidence instead of inventing it.
Do not modify files or send messages during this review.
Return findings, checked sources and unresolved limits.

deep-eval-optimizer.title: Turn one happy-path assertion into a stated evaluation contract
deep-eval-optimizer.before:
Test one successful answer.
Return pass if the answer looks good.
deep-eval-optimizer.after:
Keep the expected behavior fixed before running the candidate.
Include normal, missing-input and conflicting-evidence cases.
Score each answer against explicit, source-bound checks.
Keep setup failures separate from incorrect model answers.
Preserve answers, model/settings, usage and unsupported cases.
